1| 2|# Spoiler Spans 3| 4|With the flag `MD_FLAG_SPOILERS`, MD4C enables recognition of inline spoiler 5|spans using the `||text||` syntax (popularized by Telegram and Discord). 6| 7|A spoiler span is content wrapped in exactly two consecutive pipe characters 8|(`||`) on each side. The content is intended to be hidden by default and 9|revealed on user interaction (tap, hover, click, etc.). Rendering of the 10|hidden state is the application's responsibility; the HTML renderer wraps the 11|content in `` tags. 12| 13| 14|## Basic recognition 15| 16|```````````````````````````````` example 17|||Hello, world!|| 18|. 19|
